high_level_description: This image captures an urban street scene under a clear blue sky. The focal point is a large digital signage structure mounted on a metal framework. The sign prominently displays the words "DIGITAL SIGNAGE" in bold, black capital letters, followed by the tagline "REINVENT YOUR COMMUNICATIONS" in smaller text below. The digital signage is part of a larger structure that appears to be a covered walkway or overpass, supported by a network of blue metal beams. The underside of the structure is partially visible, showing a roof with a corrugated metal surface.
